text:
Myriad Celestia Trailer: "Deep Waters" | Honkai: Star Rail
A promotion with one's life on the line, a banquet laced with veiled threats, a secret directive that self-destructs once heard...
In the IPC's treacherous depths where undercurrents surge, not even the "Stoneheart's Oath Ring" can escape the storm...
Lies are dangerous, sure, but the truth can also leave you playing with fire. When the masks are torn away, who will have the last laugh?
